**Registration Accept is retransmitted on T3550**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / 5GMM specific procedures / Registration procedure |
| Tags | timing |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 2m25s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | stranding |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.8 c) (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has the AMF enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED on the abort, 5GMM-REGISTERED from V15.7.0; the retransmission wording is unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.4 T3550 start (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 starts T3550 when a new 5G-GUTI is allocated (as for a UE registering with a SUCI); from V15.7.0 when a 5G-GUTI or the SOR transparent container is included, with operator-defined access categories, extended emergency numbers, a new configured NSSAI and network slicing subscription change added; Rel-16: the 5G-GUTI sentence is unchanged; adds CAG information list, UE radio capability ID (or its deletion) and truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration triggers; Rel-17: the "ACCCEPT" typo is fixed; adds extended CAG information list, PEIPS assistance information, UUAA-MM pending and NSSRG triggers; the configured-NSSAI trigger applies only when roaming; Rel-18: "subclause" becomes "clause"; adds on-demand NSSAI, S-NSSAI time and location validity, NSAG and alternative NSSAI triggers; the configured-NSSAI wording leaves 5.5.1.2.4; Rel-19: adds LP-WUSPS assistance information and LP-WUS status triggers)
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.4 5G-GUTI (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "When the REGISTRATION REQUEST message includes the SUCI or PEI, ..., the AMF shall allocate a new 5G-GUTI to the UE" and "The AMF shall include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message the new assigned 5G-GUTI together with the assigned TAI list"; from V15.7.0 "The 5G-GUTI reallocation shall be part of the initial registration procedure", and the AMF includes the new 5G-GUTI "if the AMF has not allocated a new 5G-GUTI by the generic UE configuration update procedure", unchanged through V19.8.0)
- TS 24.501 Table 10.2.2 T3550 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: adds a WB-N1/CE mode value of 18s; the normal value stays 6s; Rel-17: adds 11s for access via a satellite NG-RAN cell; the normal value stays 6s)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-T3550-ACCEPT-RETRANSMIT.md).
